messages.author: 7d6a5c272d24acfa
messages.subject: Fail to pass hepatitisME bugs model with "make test-bugs" in 32bit/64bit
parts:
Hi,

   I encountered an error while running "make test-bugs" in 32bit and 64bit compilation.
Both of them failed to pass hepatititsME.stan model. I attached the error files in both compilations.

My question is, is it safe to ignore this?

Thank you for your attention and help.

Shota

My environment:
STAN:2.1.0(release version)
OS: Win 7 64bit
g++: 4.6.3 (which should come from rtools3.0)

messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Fail to pass hepatitisME bugs model with "make test-bugs" in 32bit/64bit
parts: Yes, they are safe to ignore. The model tests are stochastic tests and the Google test framework isn't designed for stochastic testing.
